scenario: A regional science conference is held over two consecutive days — Monday and Tuesday. Seven researchers — Falco, Greer, Holt, Ives, Jang, Kwan, and Lund — are each scheduled to present exactly once. On each day, presentations are given in three consecutive time slots: morning (slot 1), afternoon (slot 2), and evening (slot 3). Monday has exactly three presenters and Tuesday has exactly four presenters. The schedule is subject to the following conditions.

rules.comment: Greer presents before Holt in the overall linear order
Jang does not present in Monday evening (position 3)
Kwan does not present in Tuesday morning (position 4)
Ives presents before Lund in the overall linear order
Greer and Jang are not assigned to adjacent time slots
If Kwan is in Monday evening (slot 3), then Lund is in Tuesday evening (slot 7)
